title: FACE TO FACE
author: Han Saglam
facts: two-layer network; the 12 strongest of 127 hidden units and one bias unit draw each image
about 135,000 weights; 31 input numbers (latent) and 1,024 output cells
contract storage of the parent contract; small integers, 32 weights in each storage slot
learns inside Ethereum: 1,024 lesson transactions of integer backpropagation, 16 passes over 64 portraits
description: This work is a neural network that learned inside Ethereum. A parent contract holds the network in its storage. The artist taught it 64 public-domain portraits in 1,024 transactions. In each transaction, the contract drew a portrait from memory, measured the error, and corrected its weights. The parent creates up to 512 child contracts, called Faces. A call to a Face runs the network inside Ethereum with the Face's own seed. It returns a 32×32 grayscale face that the network was never shown. The address on this page is one Face.

call.note: face() reads the weights from the parent contract FaceToFace and runs the network on the seed. It returns 1,024 pixel bytes. The Ethereum result format adds 64 bytes.
